verdicts.reason: A: the headline and CTA lead the card clearly and the subhead is readable. But the OBSIDIAN logo has been pulled out of the card and sits small on the busy city image, the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow now falls below its own subhead (wrong reading order), and the card is jammed against the top, right and bottom edges.
